Type: Region (Mountain Range)
First Visited: Session 0

Description

The southern mountain range forming part of the L-shaped border.
Wet and cold climate with volcanic activity that is the source of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale}'s fertile ash.
Wooded slopes, mossy, shrouded in mist and steam.

Notable Features

  • Volcanic; source of the Ashen Vale's fertile ash
  • Home to @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.qiCNIVxrwzPJxFsP]{Dire Coyotes} — a tougher and more aggressive breed that dominates the lower elevations toward the Ashen Vale; humankind is sparse in the higher elevations where they roam, and few have ventured far enough to even catch sight of them
  • Contains @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tWj3TqwnEfJS9PQa]{Ashbrook} (now the cursed ruins of Eld Ashara)
  • Farlands Pass — A mountain pass used by trade caravans
  • Few mountain passes exist through the range

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} — The valley to the north, enriched by the Cinderwall's volcanic ash
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tWj3TqwnEfJS9PQa]{Ashbrook} — Former town near one of the mountain passes, now cursed ruins
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.ncbPkt06UQ9WQ2BL]{Ashen Flow} — Originates from springs beneath the Cinderwall

Associated NPCs

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} — Familiar with the mountains from his years as a beaver

Events Here

  • Session 0 — Established as the mountain range containing Ashbrook and the dire coyotes
